class_confidence_source.note: tuned by scripts/tune_class_thresholds.py; the adoption checklist required pasting these here and it had not been done, so the shipped pipeline ran on the plain 0.2 global confidence

bbox_convention.note: The official GT boxes the drawn symbol at its natural size, not our detected cell. 'canonical' replaces the size and keeps a calibrated centre; measured on the public 40-page subset: component F1 .8641 -> .8999, power .9369 -> .9616 (held-out fit gives the same numbers). Set enabled=false to restore raw detector boxes.

recommended_mode_basis: To be re-evaluated on the unchanged 59-case validation manifest once v3 weights exist; fused mode merges whole (precision) and sliced (recall) paths with class-aware WBF
adoption_checklist: Train with configs/detector_training_v3.json (and optionally v3_big); weights land at weights/detector_dataset300_v3*.pt
Rename or point this weights field at the adopted checkpoint
Run tune_class_thresholds.py on the validation split and paste its thresholds into detector.class_confidence
Re-run evaluate_detector.py --mode fused --thresholds configs/class_thresholds.json and compare against the v2 numbers before adopting

export_vocabulary.note: Official GT compares the type string exactly (only box/ic and power are aliased). Exporting resistor/capacitor/ic instead of r/c/box costs ~40 component F1 points on the public subset; it also un-collapses pin_port/testpoint/net_input which used to be flattened to vbus_in and could never match.
